description: Per-state rundown for a road trip: for each state in order, whether the home permit is recognized, whether the state has permitless carry, sources, and a summary of states where the home permit is not recognized. Up to 20 states. Not legal advice. Read-only.

home.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX) or full state name. DC is included.

states.description: State codes in travel order, e.g. ["TX","LA","MS"]. A comma-separated string is also accepted.

name: carry_route
title: Road-trip carry rundown
